text: Bitcoin's modest 1.3% decline paired with Ethereum's near-flat performance suggests a consolidation phase rather than directional conviction, while Bitcoin's dominance holding steady at 59% indicates no major rotation out of the leading asset. The Fear & Greed index at 69 (Greed) remains elevated despite slight weakening over the week, pointing to lingering optimism that hasn't yet fully capitulated despite mixed price action. Volume at $80B is healthy but not extreme, consistent with a market taking a breath before the next significant move.
